subtopics.label: Prolonged Grief Disorder: Assessment, Epidemiology, and Treatment
subtopics.description: Research on the measurement, validation, prevalence, risk factors, and treatment of Prolonged Grief Disorder (PGD), including psychometric validation of scales (PG-13, PG-13-R) across cultures, correlates such as attachment and trauma, and pharmacological or psychological interventions.
subtopics.short_description: Measurement, prevalence, risk factors, and psychological or pharmacological treatment of Prolonged Grief Disorder across cultures.

subtopics.label: Mental Health Integration in Hospice and Palliative Care
subtopics.description: Research examining the integration of behavioral health and psychiatric services into hospice and palliative care settings, including surveys of unmet mental health needs, service gaps, training competencies, and models for delivering psychiatric care to seriously ill patients.
subtopics.short_description: Models for embedding psychiatric and behavioral health services into hospice and palliative care settings to address unmet mental health needs.

subtopics.label: Hospice Utilization, Quality, and Organizational Factors
subtopics.description: Studies on patterns of hospice use, quality of care measures, site of death, and the impact of organizational factors such as private equity acquisition on hospice care delivery and patient outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Patterns of hospice use, quality-of-care measures, site of death, and effects of private equity acquisition on care delivery.

subtopics.label: Goals-of-Care Communication and Prognostic Disclosure
subtopics.description: Research on clinician-patient communication about prognosis, goals of care, and serious illness, including interventions to improve prognostic understanding, training programs for delivering bad news, and factors influencing communication quality across diverse populations.
subtopics.short_description: Clinician-patient communication about prognosis and serious illness, including training programs and interventions across diverse populations.

subtopics.label: Advance Care Planning and End-of-Life Decision-Making
subtopics.description: Studies on advance care planning practices, do-not-resuscitate orders, surrogate decision-making, and end-of-life care preferences, including disparities by race/ethnicity, immigrant status, and disability, and interventions to improve ACP engagement.
subtopics.short_description: ACP practices, surrogate decision-making, DNR orders, and end-of-life care preferences with attention to racial and disability-related disparities.

subtopics.label: Family Caregiver Burden, Well-Being, and Support Interventions
subtopics.description: Research on the physical, psychological, and social burden experienced by family caregivers of seriously ill patients, including interventions to reduce caregiver distress, improve self-efficacy, and support caregivers in hospice and home care settings.
subtopics.short_description: Physical, psychological, and social burden on family caregivers of seriously ill patients and interventions to reduce distress and improve well-being.

subtopics.label: Pain and Symptom Management in Serious Illness
subtopics.description: Research on assessment and treatment of pain and other symptoms (dyspnea, fatigue, constipation) in seriously ill patients, including opioid prescribing patterns, non-pharmacological interventions, and symptom burden in specific disease populations.
subtopics.display_name: Pain & Symptom Management in Serious Illness
subtopics.short_description: Assessment and treatment of pain, dyspnea, and fatigue in seriously ill patients, including opioid prescribing and non-pharmacological approaches.

subtopics.label: Spiritual, Religious, and Integrative Care in Palliative Settings
subtopics.description: Studies on the role of spirituality, religion, and complementary/integrative medicine (including music therapy, art therapy, and poetry) in palliative care, examining their impact on patient well-being, pain, and quality of death.
subtopics.short_description: Role of spirituality, religion, and complementary therapies such as music and art in improving well-being and quality of death.

subtopics.label: Palliative Care Education, Workforce Training, and Program Development
subtopics.description: Research on training programs, educational curricula, and workforce development in palliative and hospice medicine, including fellowship training, simulation-based education, telehealth-based education, and integration of trainees into clinical settings.
subtopics.short_description: Educational curricula, fellowship training, simulation, and telehealth-based workforce development in hospice and palliative medicine.

subtopics.label: Telehealth, COVID-19, and Palliative Care Service Delivery
subtopics.description: Studies on the adaptation of palliative care delivery during the COVID-19 pandemic, including telemedicine implementation, virtual consultations, ethics consultation during crisis, and the impact of COVID-19 on end-of-life care practices.
subtopics.short_description: Adaptation of palliative care services during COVID-19, including telemedicine implementation and pandemic impacts on end-of-life practices.

subtopics.label: Racial, Ethnic, and Socioeconomic Disparities in Palliative and End-of-Life Care
subtopics.description: Research examining disparities in access to and quality of palliative care, hospice use, advance care planning, and end-of-life outcomes among racial/ethnic minority, immigrant, and socioeconomically disadvantaged populations.
subtopics.short_description: Racial, ethnic, and socioeconomic disparities in hospice use, advance care planning, and quality of palliative care.

subtopics.label: Disorders of Consciousness: Ethics, Assessment, and Decision-Making
subtopics.description: Research on ethical, clinical, and legal issues surrounding patients with disorders of consciousness, including assessment of covert awareness, ethical frameworks for research and care, and disability rights considerations.
subtopics.short_description: Ethical, clinical, and legal issues in caring for patients with disorders of consciousness, including covert awareness assessment and disability rights.

subtopics.label: Psychiatric Comorbidities and Psychosocial Outcomes in Serious Illness
subtopics.description: Studies on the prevalence and impact of psychiatric conditions (depression, anxiety, PTSD) in patients with serious illness and their caregivers, including screening, psychosocial interventions, and the relationship between mental health and end-of-life care utilization.
subtopics.short_description: Prevalence and impact of depression, anxiety, and PTSD in seriously ill patients and caregivers, including screening and psychosocial interventions.

subtopics.label: Hospice Caregiver Experience and Home-Based Palliative Care Quality
subtopics.description: Research on caregiver-reported quality measures in home hospice care, challenges faced by hospice caregivers, and interventions to improve caregiver preparedness, symptom management support, and satisfaction with home-based end-of-life care.
subtopics.short_description: Caregiver-reported quality measures in home hospice, preparedness challenges, and interventions to improve satisfaction with home-based end-of-life care.

subtopics.label: ICU Utilization, Mechanical Ventilation, and End-of-Life Care in Critical Settings
subtopics.description: Research examining intensive care unit utilization patterns, mechanical ventilation allocation and triage, and the impact of palliative care on reducing aggressive interventions during terminal hospitalizations.
subtopics.short_description: Intensive care utilization, mechanical ventilation triage, and palliative care's role in reducing aggressive interventions during terminal hospitalizations.

subtopics.label: Quality of Life and Patient-Reported Outcomes in Interstitial Lung Disease
subtopics.description: Studies focused on measuring and improving health-related quality of life, symptom burden, and patient-centered outcomes in patients with interstitial lung diseases including idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis and hypersensitivity pneumonitis.
subtopics.display_name: Quality of Life in Interstitial Lung Disease
subtopics.short_description: Health-related quality of life, symptom burden, and patient-centered outcomes in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis and related interstitial lung diseases.

subtopics.label: Cancer Survivorship, Quality of Life, and Patient-Reported Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on long-term quality of life, symptom monitoring, and survivorship outcomes in cancer patients including breast cancer, AML, and other malignancies, often using patient-reported outcome measures.
subtopics.short_description: Long-term quality of life, symptom monitoring, and survivorship outcomes in cancer patients using patient-reported outcome measures.

subtopics.label: Geriatric Assessment and Care for Older Adults with Serious Illness
subtopics.description: Studies applying geriatric assessment tools and frameworks to older adults with serious illnesses such as cancer, heart failure, dementia, and HIV, examining functional outcomes, care quality, and multimorbidity.
subtopics.short_description: Geriatric assessment frameworks applied to older adults with cancer, heart failure, dementia, and HIV to improve functional outcomes and care quality.

subtopics.label: Crisis Standards of Care, Resource Allocation, and Pandemic Ethics
subtopics.description: Ethical and policy analyses of resource allocation, triage protocols, and crisis standards of care during pandemics and public health emergencies, including equity concerns for vulnerable populations.
subtopics.short_description: Ethical and policy analysis of triage protocols, crisis standards of care, and equity concerns for vulnerable populations during public health emergencies.

subtopics.label: High-Cost Medicare Patients and End-of-Life Spending Patterns
subtopics.description: Research characterizing high-cost Medicare beneficiaries, geographic variation in spending, and potentially preventable or wasteful expenditures at the end of life.
subtopics.short_description: Geographic variation, high-cost beneficiary profiles, and potentially preventable expenditures in Medicare end-of-life spending.

subtopics.label: Caregiver Health, Self-Care, and Physician Engagement with Caregiver Needs
subtopics.description: Studies examining how caregiving roles affect caregivers' own health behaviors and self-care, including medication misuse, diabetes management, and physician motivations to address caregiver needs.
subtopics.short_description: Effects of caregiving roles on caregivers' own health behaviors, including medication misuse, chronic disease management, and physician engagement.

subtopics.label: Digital Health and mHealth Interventions for Symptom Monitoring and Self-Management
subtopics.description: Research on mobile health applications, electronic patient-reported outcomes, and virtual care platforms designed to monitor symptoms and support self-management in patients with serious illness or cancer.
subtopics.short_description: Mobile apps, electronic patient-reported outcomes, and virtual platforms for symptom monitoring and self-management in serious illness.

subtopics.label: Aggressiveness of End-of-Life Care and Social Determinants
subtopics.description: Studies examining how social support, interpersonal relationships, financial burden, and racial/ethnic background influence the aggressiveness of care and resource utilization at the end of life.
subtopics.short_description: Influence of social support, financial burden, and racial background on care intensity and resource utilization at the end of life.

subtopics.label: Clinical Ethics Consultation and Ethical Dilemmas in Hospital Care
subtopics.description: Research on ethics consultation services in hospital settings, including surgical specialties, elder mistreatment, periviability counseling, and the role of power dynamics in clinical decision-making.
subtopics.short_description: Ethics consultation services in hospital settings, covering elder mistreatment, periviability counseling, and power dynamics in clinical decision-making.

subtopics.label: Medical Aid in Dying, Deprescribing, and End-of-Life Treatment Decisions
subtopics.description: Studies on physician participation in medical aid in dying, patient and provider attitudes toward deprescribing in serious illness, and decision-making around treatment intensity near the end of life.
subtopics.short_description: Physician participation in medical aid in dying, attitudes toward deprescribing, and decision-making around treatment intensity near end of life.
